name: Lokalise WRITE - Realchecker FE tagged targets realign to new EN (one-off)
description: WRITE one-off: re-aligns all 22 target languages of Realchecker FE keys tagged with Config.tag (now 1910: image testimonials, upload errors, info modal guideline) to the current EN. EN never written. Guards: EN/target unchanged, linguist edits held.

parameters.jsCode:
const g = $('Gate').all().map(function (i) { return i.json; });
return [{ json: { results: $input.all().map(function (r, i) { const b = r.json.body || {}; return { iso: (g[i] || {}).iso, sent: (g[i] || {}).n, status: r.json.statusCode, written: (b.keys || []).length, errors: b.errors || b.error || null }; }) } }];
